// Guard fixture: scan_scoped, honest and rubber stamp.
//
// scan_scoped is the second allowed form of scoping: a read pinned to a
// NAMED scan rather than to the current corpus. The drift detector needs
// it, because it runs before the scan is marked completed and a
// view-based read would compare the new state against itself.
//
// The state is only worth having if it is checked. Both functions below
// are registered scan_scoped; only one actually scopes. The guard must
// pass the first and fail the second, or "scan_scoped" becomes a phrase
// that excuses any read at all.

package fixture

// PriorForScan scopes to the scan under evaluation, visibly.
func PriorForScan() string {
	return `
		SELECT rule_id, current_status
		  FROM host_rule_state
		 WHERE host_id = $1 AND last_scan_id = $2`
}

// ClaimsToBeScoped is registered scan_scoped and scopes nothing.
func ClaimsToBeScoped() string {
	return `
		SELECT rule_id, current_status
		  FROM host_rule_state
		 WHERE host_id = $1`
}
